INFO_about-why-text-first: This site has been developed based on my conviction that the free formation of opinions is the prerequisite of a free society.
INFO_about-why-text-second: Whether it’s blasphemy, hate speech, criticism, or other points of view, which people want removed for ideological reasons: On this site they all have a safe place to exist, a Safe Space.
INFO_about-why-text-third: All entries have been submitted by other users and exist to challenge ideas by preserving them. The views on the site are not my own, nor are they representative of them.
INFO_about-how-text-one: You can sort, filter and search through existing entries by using the settings. To open the settings click the cog wheel.
INFO_about-how-text-two: If you wish to submit a new text for the site, use the icon next to the settings. All entries will be inspected during regular livestreams.
INFO_about-how-text-three: Alternatively you can interact with the individual entries by clicking them directly.
